tools.name: list_demandas
tools.title: List condominium demands
tools.description: List demands tracked in Notion across every condominium registered in the index sheet. Supports optional filters, including filtering to a single condominium.

status.description: Exact status to filter by, e.g. 'Feito', 'Em andamento', 'Não iniciado', 'Assembleia', 'Atrasado', 'Cancelado'.

prioridade.description: Priority level to filter by (matches if present among the demand's priorities): 'Baixa', 'Média', 'Alta', 'Urgente', or 'Grande Investimento'.

responsavel.description: Filter by responsible person name (case-insensitive substring).

tools.name: get_weekly_summary
tools.title: Weekly summary of demands
tools.description: Return an executive summary with KPIs (total, completed, cancelled, in progress, pending, urgent), plus counts by responsible, status and category, across every condominium registered in the index sheet.

tools.name: get_priority_demandas
tools.title: High-priority open demands
tools.description: List only the demands classified as 'Alta', 'Urgente' or 'Grande Investimento' that are not yet completed or cancelled, across every registered condominium.
